CustomField.description: Compares Health_Status__c to Prior_Health_Status__c using the live picklist values Healthy, Needs Attention, Off Track. 2026-10-28: replaced the old On Track and At Risk labels that never matched.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Prior_Health_Status__c), "New", IF(TEXT(Health_Status__c) = Prior_Health_Status__c, "Same", IF(OR( AND(TEXT(Health_Status__c) = "Healthy", Prior_Health_Status__c <> "Healthy"), AND(TEXT(Health_Status__c) = "Needs Attention", Prior_Health_Status__c = "Off Track") ), "Improved", "Declined")))
CustomField.label: Status Change
